title: Chapter close — Bring's Surface
html:
Chapter close — Bring's Surface.

This closes the Bring's-surface chapter. The archimedean base—the genus-4 surface \Sigma_4 with Euler characteristic \chi = -6—functions as the QOU spacetime. We fixed the Descartes / archimedean condition via the genus-ideal characterisation. We assembled the colour-tube coordinates and spectral gauge.

The volume-mass duality chapter pairs the hyperbolic-volume content of Bring's surface with the categorical mass content extracted from the eigenbasis. The subsequent chapters specialise the resulting duality to atomic isotopes and the \beta-decay Q-value predictions.
